jobs.description:
* **Role Title:**
  Business Analyst (Korean Language)
* **Role Type:**
  Full-time
* **Location**
  : Remote

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

**What does day-to-day look like:**

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

1. Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)

2. In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?

Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

**Requirements**
:

1. Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Korean)

2. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills

3. Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.

4. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.

5. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

6. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.

7. Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

8. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.

2. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)

3. Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

4. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

**Offer Details:**

1. Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

2. Commitments Required :Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los\_Angeles

**What You’ll Do**

1. You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better.

jobs.title: Senior Vessel Schedule Reliability Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Vessel Schedule Reliability Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

The Senior Vessel Schedule Reliability Specialist is responsible for analyzing, monitoring, and improving vessel schedule performance across international shipping networks. The role focuses on schedule adherence, port-call reliability, transit-time performance, voyage delays, carrier service consistency, and disruption analysis. Working fully remotely, the specialist collaborates with shipping lines, freight forwarders, port operations teams, logistics planners, and supply chain stakeholders to identify schedule risks, evaluate operational trends, and provide data-driven recommendations that improve shipment predictability and service performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor vessel schedule performance across assigned shipping routes, trade lanes, and carrier services.
* Analyze scheduled versus actual departure and arrival times to measure schedule reliability.
* Track vessel delays, port omissions, blank sailings, rollovers, schedule changes, and service disruptions.
* Evaluate on-time performance at origin ports, transshipment hubs, and destination ports.
* Review vessel rotation schedules, estimated time of arrival (ETA), estimated time of departure (ETD), and actual time records.
* Assess transit-time performance and identify recurring deviations from published service commitments.
* Analyze port congestion, berth waiting times, weather disruptions, equipment shortages, and other factors affecting schedule reliability.
* Monitor vessel tracking information and carrier schedule updates using relevant maritime data platforms.
* Compare schedule performance across carriers, shipping services, trade lanes, and reporting periods.
* Develop reliability dashboards, performance scorecards, and exception reports for internal stakeholders.
* Identify recurring delay patterns and investigate root causes of schedule deviations.
* Evaluate the impact of vessel delays on container connections, cargo availability, delivery commitments, and downstream logistics plans.
* Coordinate remotely with shipping lines, freight forwarders, and logistics teams to obtain schedule updates and clarify operational exceptions.
* Review transshipment connection risks and assess the likelihood of missed connecting vessel departures.
* Support shipment planning teams with schedule risk assessments and alternative routing recommendations.
* Monitor changes to vessel rotations, port calls, sailing frequencies, and carrier service structures.
* Maintain accurate records of schedule changes, delay reasons, performance indicators, and corrective actions.
* Prepare periodic reports on vessel schedule reliability, carrier performance, and route-level operational trends.
* Recommend improvements to carrier selection criteria, schedule buffers, shipment planning, and disruption management procedures.
* Support supplier performance reviews and service-level agreement assessments using verified schedule performance data.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving shipping visibility, schedule data quality, and logistics performance measurement.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Shipping and Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Transport Management, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience

Job title: Accountant

Company: Verve Wellness (All Well Home Healthcare LLC,DHA-licensed) — a MACWISE Capital portfolio company

Location: Dubai, UAE (office-based, JLT)

Reports to: Head of Finance, Verve Wellness

Experience: 4–5 years in accounting, with at least 2 years in the

UAE

**Role purpose**

The Accountant owns Verve's day-to-day books, vendor reconciliations and inventory

accounting. The role is partly external-facing: you will work directly with suppliers,

pharmacies, labs and partners to agree statements of account, resolve differences and

keep payables clean. You keep the numbers accurate so leadership can make fast,

confident decisions.

**Key responsibilities**

Vendor reconciliation and stakeholder liaison (client-facing)

* Reconcile monthly statements of account (SOAs) from all vendors — pharmacies,labs, medical suppliers and operational vendors — against the ledger.
* Contact vendors directly to agree balances, resolve missing invoices, duplicate billing,credit notes and payment mismatches.
* Issue balance confirmations and maintain a clear, documented trail for every open item.
* Track vendor credit terms (e.g. 45 days for clinical suppliers, 15 days for operational vendors) and flag overdue items before they escalate.
* Prepare the weekly payables ageing and propose payment runs by priority and due date.
* Handle customer and partner receivables queries, including corporate clients, insurers and referral partners where applicable.

**Core accounting**

* Record purchases, sales, receipts, payments and journals accurately in Tally (orequivalent ERP).
* Perform monthly bank, cash, card and payment-gateway reconciliations.
* Support month-end close: accruals, prepayments, provisions and intercompany entries across MACWISE group entities.
* Maintain petty cash, staff expense claims and supporting documentation.

**Inventory management**

* Maintain inventory records for medications, IV supplies and medical consumables.
* Reconcile physical stock counts to system records monthly; investigate and report variances.
* Monitor expiry dates, batch details and slow-moving stock; flag write-offs and wastage.
* Match goods received to purchase orders and invoices (three-way match) before posting.
* Report inventory valuation and cost of goods sold for monthly P&L.

**Compliance and reporting**

* Prepare UAE VAT workings and support quarterly VAT returns.
* Support UAE Corporate Tax records, audit schedules and external auditors.
* Produce monthly MIS: payables, receivables, inventory and cash position.
* Keep files audit-ready and in line with internal controls and DHA documentation needs.

**Requirements**

Experience- 4–5 years in general accounting; at least 2 years in the UAE, Healthcare, pharmacy, clinic or trading background

Qualification-Bachelor's in Accounting, Commerce or Finance, CA Inter, ACCA (part or full),CMA

Reconciliations: Proven vendor SOA and bank reconciliation experience

Inventory- Hands-on stock reconciliation and inventory valuation Batch and expiry tracking for medical or pharma stock

Tally; advanced Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivots), Zoho Books, QuickBooks or

Odoo; Google Sheets

Working knowledge of UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax exposure

Fluent written and spoken English,Hindi, Malayalam or Arabic

**Personal attributes**

* Confident on the phone and email with vendors; firm but courteous when chasing differences.
* Detail-driven: closes every open item rather than carrying it forward.
